event_time.note: Inherited from incidents.csv. The Swedish prosecutor states only that the damage was discovered during the night of 26 January, so this is a replay anchor rather than a verified contact time.

location.note: Approximate midpoint between Gotland and Latvia from incidents.csv; not a forensic contact coordinate.

vessel.name: Vezhen
vessel.association: The Swedish prosecutor stated that the seized vessel caused the cable break.

physical_cause.label: vessel_caused_cable_break
physical_cause.basis: The official investigation attributed the break to the vessel and to a combination of weather, equipment deficiencies, and seamanship deficiencies.

intent_assessment.label: not_sabotage
intent_assessment.basis: The Swedish prosecutor stated that the investigation clearly established that the event was not sabotage.

legal_status.label: sabotage_ruled_out_other_possible_offences_still_under_review_in_latest_cited_update
legal_status.basis: The vessel seizure was lifted; the preliminary investigation continued at that point only to determine whether other offences might be suspected.

timeline.description: Replay anchor during the night in which the Latvia-Sweden communications cable damage was discovered.
A preliminary investigation into suspected aggravated sabotage was opened and a vessel was seized.
The prosecutor ruled out sabotage, attributed the break to the seized vessel, and cited weather, equipment deficiencies, and seamanship deficiencies.

evidence.finding: Interviews, seized material and crime-scene examinations supported the finding that the seized vessel caused the break and that it was not sabotage.
The prosecutor identified a combination of weather conditions, equipment deficiencies and seamanship deficiencies.

ais_track.note: No validated incident vessel track is packaged in this dossier.

gfw_identity_summary.caveat: Aggregate GFW event counts are not an incident track and do not prove behaviour at the cable. Similar DE ZHEN records are excluded as name collisions.

weather_sample.caveat: Open-Meteo model/reanalysis sample at the approximate segment midpoint; it provides context but does not independently prove the prosecutor's weather finding.

sentinel_catalogue.note: Catalogue availability only. The closest listed optical scene is fully cloud-covered.

demo_guidance.safe_summary: A confirmed vessel-caused cable break that the Swedish investigation ruled was not sabotage; weather, equipment and seamanship deficiencies contributed.

weather conditions that can increase anchor and handling risk

demo_guidance.do_not_say: Do not call this sabotage or use proximity to a Russian port as evidence of intent.
